info.title: Consus Gateway API
info.description: Consus Gateway routes AI inference to government-authorized cloud infrastructure (FedRAMP, DoD IL2/IL4/IL5, ITAR) behind OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible surfaces. Point an existing OpenAI or Anthropic client at this API and change only the base URL and API key. See https://gateway.consus.io for full documentation, including model coverage, reasoning, tool use, and error handling.

get.description: Returns service health status. The only endpoint that does not require an API key.
Returns every requestable composite model ID (base model plus compliance level, e.g. `claude-sonnet-4-5:itar`, `gpt-5.6-sol:il5+itar`). Only models with an active provider integration are returned.

post.description: OpenAI Chat Completions-compatible endpoint. The primary, multi-provider endpoint for generating AI responses: text, multi-turn conversation, tool use, vision (image input), and extended reasoning via `reasoning_effort`. Requests route to the government cloud provider that serves the requested model.

200.description: Chat completion (or, with `stream: true`, a `text/event-stream` of chat completion chunks terminated by `data: [DONE]`).

schema.description: Server-sent events, one JSON chat-completion-chunk object per `data:` line.

post.summary: Create a message (native Anthropic Messages API)
post.description: Native Anthropic Messages API for Claude models only — no translation layer, so Anthropic SDKs and Anthropic-format clients (Claude Code, Claude Desktop) point here directly. The compliance level in `model` selects the government cloud provider. For Google or OpenAI models, use `/v1/chat/completions` instead. The gateway validates `model`, `messages`, and `max_tokens`; every other Anthropic Messages API field passes through unchanged.

200.description: Anthropic Messages API response (or, with `stream: true`, an Anthropic-format `text/event-stream`).

schema.description: Anthropic-format server-sent events (message_start, content_block_delta, message_stop, etc.).

post.summary: Count tokens for a Messages API request
post.description: Returns the input token count a `/v1/messages` request would consume, without generating a completion. Accepts the same body as `/v1/messages`; `max_tokens` is accepted and ignored (it is an output-side cap and cannot change the input count).

200.description: Token count for the given request.

post.description: OpenAI Responses API for GPT models on Azure Government OpenAI and AWS GovCloud Bedrock. This is the endpoint Codex CLI targets when configured with `wire_api = "responses"`. A thin proxy to the provider's native Responses API, restricted to GPT models. The gateway is stateless: `store: true` and `previous_response_id` are rejected with `400`.

200.description: Provider response payload (or, with `stream: true`, a `text/event-stream`).

post.description: OpenAI Embeddings-compatible endpoint. Generates vector embeddings for one or more input strings for semantic search, retrieval, and RAG. Up to 512 strings per request, 2 MB total; oversized input returns `400` rather than being truncated.

200.description: Embedding vectors, one per input string, in input order.

ApiKeyAuth.name: x-api-key
ApiKeyAuth.description: Standard inference API key. Grants access to all inference endpoints (`/v1/chat/completions`, `/v1/messages`, `/v1/messages/count_tokens`, `/v1/responses`, `/v1/embeddings`) and `GET /v1/models`. Can't call the Management API (returns `403`). Not required on `GET /health`. Each key carries a requests-per-second limit, a burst allowance, and a monthly quota, enforced at the API Gateway layer before the request reaches the application. Issued by Consus on request — see https://gateway.consus.io/authentication.

ManagementApiKeyAuth.name: x-api-key
ManagementApiKeyAuth.description: Management key. One per organization, issued by Consus on request. Calls only the Management API (`/v1/keys`, `/v1/org`, `/v1/spend`, `/v1/logs`) and only for your organization. Can't run inference or touch management keys. Expires after 180 days. See https://gateway.consus.io/management-api.

InvalidRequestError.description: Bad request: invalid model, missing fields, validation failure, or payload exceeds limits.

PermissionError.description: Invalid or missing API key, or access denied to the requested model.

RateLimitError.description: API key rate limit / monthly quota exceeded, or an upstream model rate limit after one automatic retry.

ServerError.description: Internal server error, or the upstream provider was unavailable / returned a server error.

TimeoutError.description: Request exceeded its maximum duration (5 minutes non-streaming, ~15 minutes streaming). Not automatically retried.

id.description: Composite model ID to use in requests, listed with the `consus/` prefix (requests accept it with or without), e.g. `consus/claude-sonnet-4-5:itar`.

display_name.description: Human-readable model name, without the compliance level (read that from `id`).

max_output_tokens.description: Largest `max_tokens` the model accepts. `null` for embedding models.

reasoning_efforts.description: `reasoning_effort` values the model honors, weakest first. `[]` = no reasoning (a sent `reasoning_effort` is accepted and ignored). A value above the last entry is lowered to it rather than rejected.

ModelPricing.description: USD per 1M tokens for this ID. Priced per ID because the compliance level can select a different cloud. Standard rates; GPT-5.6 long-context rates are documented separately. A rate the model doesn't offer is 0.

cache_read.description: Cache reads; 0 when the model has no cache-read rate.

cache_write.description: Cache writes (5-minute); 0 when the model has no cache-write rate.

content.description: Plain string (max 2 MB), or an array of content parts (`text`, `image_url`) for vision input.

tool_call_id.description: On tool messages: the id of the tool call this message responds to.

parameters.description: JSON Schema for the tool's arguments.

x_consus_governance.description: Present only when a tool call's arguments contain an outbound destination (URL, s3://, mailto:, raw IP, etc). Advisory only — the tool call is not modified or blocked.

MessagesRequest.description: Native Anthropic Messages API body. The gateway validates model, messages, and max_tokens; every other field (system, temperature, top_p, tools, tool_choice, stop_sequences, metadata, stream, thinking, ...) passes through unchanged to Anthropic's Messages API. See https://docs.anthropic.com/en/api/messages for the full upstream schema.

model.description: A Claude model with a compliance level, e.g. `claude-sonnet-4-5:itar`. Bare model names return 400.

MessagesResponse.description: Native Anthropic Messages API response, with an optional x_consus_governance field (same shape as on /v1/chat/completions) appended when tool-output governance flags are present.

store.description: Must be false or omitted — the gateway is stateless and rejects true with 400.

previous_response_id.description: Not accepted — rejected with 400. Send the full input array each turn.

ResponsesResponse.description: The provider's Responses API payload, unchanged, with an optional x_consus_governance field appended.

input.description: Text to embed. Up to 512 strings per request, 2 MB total. Token arrays are not accepted.

embedding.description: Array of floats, or a base64 string of little-endian float32 values when encoding_format is base64.

status.description: HTTP status returned to the caller, as a string.

next_cursor.description: Opaque. Pass back as `cursor` to fetch the next page. Only meaningful when has_more is true.

monthly_limit_usd.description: Per-key monthly cap. `null` means the organization cap applies.
Per-key monthly cap. `null` means the organization cap applies.

owner.description: Who owns the key. Can't change later.

requested_monthly_limit_usd.description: Capped at your organization's limit. Leave out for the default.
